blocks.title: Read the illustrated introduction inside Astravia
blocks.description: The Qiushi Methodology skill ships a one-page illustrated introduction. This companion opens that page — the shipped file itself, not a screenshot — from the ability detail page, and keeps it one click away in the sidebar.

items.title: One click from the ability page
items.description: A card sits directly under the install header of the Qiushi Methodology detail page; its button opens the page.

items.title: The page, not a picture
items.description: It renders the package's own assets/preview/index.html, so nothing goes stale when the package is updated.

items.title: Never drifts from the skill
items.description: The copy of the page that ships in this plugin is compared byte for byte with the skill package on every build.

items.title: No setup, no network
items.description: No file paths to configure, no browser to launch, and nothing downloaded at view time.

items.title: Install this plugin
items.description: The Qiushi Methodology skill on its own keeps the page closed; this plugin is what adds the entry that opens it.

items.title: Open the Qiushi Methodology detail page
items.description: The illustrated-introduction card appears under the install button.

items.title: Click Open the page
items.description: The introduction opens at full width inside Astravia, and stays reachable from the sidebar afterwards.

blocks.content: Requires Astravia 0.5.59 or newer. The page is bundled with this plugin, so it opens offline even before the Qiushi Methodology skill is installed; install that skill to get the workflows the page describes.
